notes: Paper derives new constraints on ALP-proton coupling from diffuse galactic flux of MeV-mass ALPs produced in core-collapse supernovae, detected via a→pγ interactions in Super-Kamiokande water Cherenkov detector. Exclusion region spans one order of magnitude in g_ap between ~2×10^-5 and ~2×10^-4 for m_a in range 1–70 MeV, above SN 1987A cooling bounds. Data extracted from abstract and Fig. 4. The coupling is defined as g_ap = g_a × C_ap where g_a = m_N/f_a and C_ap = -0.47 (KSVZ-inspired model). Projected HK bounds also presented but marked as projection. Confidence level is 95% C.L. per Wilks' theorem (Appendix B). The exclusion is a bounded region in the (m_a, g_ap) plane; encoded as two-point horizontal lines at the mass boundaries to represent the coupling range at each mass extreme. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.85, 4))
